mapper.insert: INSERT INTO messages (member_id, from_admin, content) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{fromAdmin}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM messages WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT messages.*, members.nickname FROM messages JOIN members ON messages.member_id = members.id WHERE messages.id IN ( SELECT MAX(id) FROM messages GROUP BY member_id ) ORDER BY messages.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND from_admin = 1 AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE messages SET is_read = 1 WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND from_admin = 1 AND is_read = 0
